notes: Shortcuts preview is now your actual saved shortcuts with their actual icons, not a generic sample — and it's the whole list now: the old icon+name+Remove rows below Find/Or-a-link are gone, hover a tile and click to remove it there…

Fixed a real bug: the widget previews (Computer, Media, Shortcuts) were still sitting on a visible background box behind them — the frame was gone but the fill color wasn't, and on top of that a fully transparent iframe rendered solid…

Fixed "Volume, Brightness & Microphone" (and every other preview heading) wrapping to two lines despite having the whole row — it was reusing a label style meant for a narrow field caption, not a heading.
More vertical padding around each preview (16px to 24px), and Video now has its own heading like its neighbors instead of sitting unlabeled under Media Player.
Preview boxes now size themselves to whatever they're actually showing — a two-row slider card and a five-tile shortcut grid each get exactly the room they need — instead of guessing a fixed height.
